kyun-hua.health: The channel is far off-track for YPP subscriber targets, but recent focus on high-interest domestic incidents shows strong view spikes compared to general news.
working: Domestic incident and attack topics perform significantly above baseline, with the Tiger Shroff attack series reaching up to 1,065 views.
Automation reliability is high, with zero run or health failures over the last 7 days.
not_working: Subscriber conversion is critically low at 3.4 subscribers per 1,000 views, pushing full YPP qualification over 1,300 days away.
Global news and diplomacy topics underperform consistently, with category 'world' showing a x0.839 ranking lift compared to baseline.
kyun-hua.ypp_lever: Add strong visual and spoken subscribe call-to-actions paired with pinned comments on high-performing domestic news Shorts to accelerate subscriber conversion, which is the binding constraint.

inauthentic_risk.why: Using Gemini TTS AI voice with visual parallax photo templates risks being flagged as repetitive auto-generated content by YPP reviewers unless original editorial depth, distinct storytelling, and synthetic voice disclosures are maintained.

recommendations.change: Add a spoken call-to-action and end-screen subscription graphic to the final 5 seconds of each Short.
recommendations.evidence: Subscriber conversion is currently 3.4 subs per 1,000 views, making subscriber growth the primary bottleneck to YPP eligibility.

recommendations.change: Hypothesize prioritizing domestic incident and court topics over generic world news.
recommendations.evidence: Category 'attack' shows early lift of x1.35 (median 106 views) and 'court' x1.167 vs 'world' at x0.839 (median 26 views) across early data.

recommendations.change: Ensure explicit AI audio disclosures are declared in video upload metadata and description tags.
recommendations.evidence: YPP guidelines strictly flag non-disclosed AI synthetic voices and automated personas during monetization review.

pangaea.ypp_lever: Fix and execute the promotion workflow so every trailer Short automatically links to its corresponding long-form video, leveraging Shorts views (up to 75 views) to build the missing 3,000 long-form watch hours.

inauthentic_risk.why: Strict code gates enforce factual grounding from Wikipedia revisions, unique assets per episode, CLIP filtering, and clear synthetic disclosures, satisfying YPP original value requirements.

recommendations.change: Diagnose and restore the automated promotion pipeline to pin and link published Shorts to their long-form episodes.
